verdict.rationale: ASC 718 expense reporting is a fair question for an equity-management product like Carta, so the axis applies. The pack only documents building blocks: an option-grants API, 409A fair market values, and an exercise-tax FMV API. None of it shows Carta producing stock-based compensation expense reports or audit-ready ASC 718 output. Fund journal entries and financial statements belong to the investor side and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors
